About the Practice

Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) is a leading cancer treatment and research institution and a National Cancer Institute–designated Comprehensive Cancer Center based in New York City, with locations in New York and New Jersey. [2, 14] Dedicated exclusively to cancer, MSK provides personalized, compassionate, expert care for hundreds of cancer subtypes across all ages, integrating patient care with innovative translational and clinical research conducted at the Sloan Kettering Institute to improve prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. [9, 13, 15] MSK also offers extensive educational programs for future clinicians and scientists and provides a full range of support services for patients and their families. [13, 15]

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC) uses a patient portal branded as MSK MyChart. This portal was formerly known as MyMSK. The MSK MyChart patient portal is provided by Epic Systems. MyChart is widely recognized as the patient portal integrated with Epic's electronic health record (EHR) system, used by many hospitals and healthcare systems.
